source.cohort_sql:
SELECT ea_id, symbol
FROM work_items
WHERE phase IN ('Q02','P2')
GROUP BY ea_id, symbol
HAVING SUM(
           CASE
             WHEN status IN ('done','failed')
              AND verdict IS NOT NULL
              AND TRIM(verdict) <> ''
              AND UPPER(verdict) <> 'INFRA_FAIL'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END
       ) = 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('pending','active') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(verdict) = 'INFRA_FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 12

classification_contract.zero_trade_identity_requirement: All identity checks in valid_zero_identity_checks must be true.
classification_contract.generic_summary_missing_policy: Generic summary_missing labels alone are not promoted to a causal defect.
classification_contract.setfile_duplicate_policy: Comments are excluded; case-insensitive duplicate header and input keys are split into identical and conflicting value classes.

governed_canary_proposal.top_cause_definition: Five largest actionable runtime/evidence primary causes; 206/244 defect pairs (84.4%).
global_preconditions: Claude review of this classification and the exact candidate list.
OWNER authorization for the bounded sequential canary.
Immediate read-only revalidation: target row still terminal INFRA_FAIL; pair has no pending/active successor or non-infra disposition.
Canonical EX5 and setfile exist and hashes match row-bound expectations.
News calendar source and FILE_COMMON copies are fresh and identical; qm_news_stale_max_hours remains <=336.
Backtest setfile uses RISK_FIXED > 0 and RISK_PERCENT = 0.
No active T1-T10 backtest is interrupted.
governed_canary_proposal.global_abort: On any identity mismatch, live successor, recurrent unexplained infrastructure signature, or missing terminal evidence: stop; enqueue nothing else.

groups.release_policy: Sequential: row 2 remains unqueued until row 1 has a reviewed terminal disposition.
groups.expected: One identity-bound terminal Q02 disposition: PASS, MIN_TRADES_NOT_MET, or deterministic INVALID with an attributable init event; never another generic INFRA label.
groups.abort: Stop the cause group after the first recurrent ONINIT_FAILED lacking a row-bound init event, or any EX5/setfile/calendar identity mismatch.
groups.precondition: Explain or repair the exact init failure first; revalidate current EX5, setfile and calendar hashes.

groups.release_policy: Sequential: row 2 remains unqueued until row 1 has a reviewed terminal disposition.
groups.expected: The progress-aware reaper permits completion, or records a justified no-progress/absolute-ceiling stop with bound progress evidence.
groups.abort: Stop after any reap while forward progress is present, any reap without progress evidence, or any vanished terminal disposition.
groups.precondition: Confirm the progress-aware reaper commit is deployed and the row is mechanically eligible.

groups.release_policy: Sequential: row 2 remains unqueued until row 1 has a reviewed terminal disposition.
groups.expected: Cold-cache handling produces nonzero bars and a valid terminal report, or a deterministic INVALID history diagnosis.
groups.abort: Stop after the first recurrent BARS_ZERO following successful symbol/date coverage preflight; do not fan out to another terminal.
groups.precondition: Read-only symbol/date coverage and cache preflight must pass on the assigned terminal.

groups.release_policy: Sequential: row 2 remains unqueued until row 1 has a reviewed terminal disposition.
groups.expected: The requested date range is available and the run reaches a valid terminal report without NO_HISTORY.
groups.abort: Stop after the first recurrent NO_HISTORY/BARS_ZERO after coverage preflight, or evidence that the requested range is unavailable.
groups.precondition: Read-only history-range validation must cover the exact requested window; no history re-import is authorized.

groups.release_policy: Sequential: row 2 remains unqueued until row 1 has a reviewed terminal disposition.
groups.expected: A repaired EA produces a bounded journal and a valid terminal report without LOG_BOMB.
groups.abort: Kill the single canary at the configured log-bomb guard and stop the cause group on the first LOG_BOMB signature or unbounded journal growth.
groups.precondition: Code/logging repair and focused regression proof first. Never flip the poison source row; create one governed successor referencing it.

no_candidate_categories.SETFILE_DUPLICATE: 0 current cohort pairs with identical/conflicting duplicate header or input keys; repair the setfile before any canary.
no_candidate_categories.SETFILE_HEADER_INCOMPLETE: 3 pairs; repair evidence headers before considering a run.
no_candidate_categories.SETFILE_MISSING: 13 pairs; restore/regenerate a canonical setfile before considering a run.
no_candidate_categories.ROW_BOUND_PASS_DISPOSITION_MISMATCH: 10 pairs; review a guarded disposition repair, not a rerun.
no_candidate_categories.UNCLEAR: 33 pairs; forensic recovery of logs/aggregates first, no blind requeue.
